description: Set which columns are shown (pre-fillable) on a record template. Pass an empty array to show all columns. isPartialSelection:true means only listed columns are shown; false means all are shown.

columnIds.description: Ordered list of field IDs to show. Empty array shows all.

debug.description: When true, include raw Airtable response in output for diagnostics

isPartialSelection.description: true = show only listed columns; false = show all. Default: true

name: set_record_template_visible_columns
